article.title: Election Defenders Organize For the Best, Prepare For the Worst
article.author: Sandra Hinson
article.content: With horns, trumpets, clarinets and flutes belting melodies and drums laying down a beat to move the sleepiest feet, the 19-piece Brass Liberation Orchestra took the stage to open Bay Resistance’s August “Get Ready” People’s Assembly. “All we need to beat fascism is each other,” the presentation’s lead slide reminded attendees.
